title: Car codes for the conversation with the mechanic
description: The raw result of the read and an explanation you can follow are kept side by side.

blocks.text: Having seen a warning, the owner wants to work out what data is available. A failed connection and an incomplete read have to be told apart from there being no fault.

quote.text: The best thing for me is how it tells you how serious a problem is and if it’s okay to keep driving or not. I also like the live data stuff and how it explains codes in a way that actually makes sense.

blocks.text: Check the supported pairing of car and adapter. Save the code, the time and the available parameters into a report for the conversation that follows.
A single code does not establish the cause of a fault. Do not promise compatibility with every adapter, the cost of a repair, or permission to keep driving.
